title: Bibliometric explorer (synthetic demonstration)
summary: Filter a publication table by year, country, theme, method and institution, and watch counts, shares and trends recompute in the browser.
research_question: How do publication volume and focus change over time across countries, themes and methods in sanitation research?
status_rationale: The data are invented. The experiment demonstrates the software and its verified calculations; it reproduces no thesis result and says nothing about real sanitation literature.
ui_notice: SYNTHETIC DATA. These 600 records were generated by a script. No number here describes real research.

parameters.label: Country
parameters.help: Leave all unticked to include every country.

validation_rules.description: Dataset checksum matches its record, columns match the schema, all rows parse, the runner returns without error.
Every metric equals an independent Python re-implementation on each reference scenario.

limitations: Synthetic data only. Filtering and counting are verified; the research meaning is not.
Reference outputs come from an independent re-implementation, not from a published thesis result, so they support EXPLORATORY status only.
The yearly trend slope is a descriptive least-squares fit with no significance test.
unresolved: Authentic bibliographic records (and the systematic-review S-prefixed identifiers) are not available. See docs/RESEARCH_CONTEXT.md.
